decision.explanation: Document D2S13 explicitly states that 'Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, is, in fact, an integral part of Anglicare Sydney.' Additional supporting details include the shared governance structure under the Anglicare Sydney Board and the official listing of Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, as a subsidiary of Anglicare Sydney in the ACNC register (D2S18–D2S19). These confirm the direct organizational relationship. While D1S9 mentions 'Anglican Retirement Villages' as an operational entity, it does not establish a part-of relationship with the full name 'Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney,' and D1S1 explicitly denies a connection to 'Wii Menu.' Therefore, 'Anglicare Sydney' is the only valid and supported answer.
